text:
pagerbot: [ALERT] auth telemetry anomaly detected on SSO-Edge (INC-2026-0423-17). 1.2k failed assertions from 203.0.113.0/24 over the last 7m. Paging #oncall.
eli: Oncall here, looking now.
maya: seeing repeated `x-debug-token` header in edge logs, small debug payloads forwarded to an external S3 path.
secops: starting containment — blocking 203.0.113.0/24 at edge-proxy ACLs, suspending idp client 'ci-runner-497'.
eli: do it. also we should rotate service token for that idp client immediately. who owns the secret?
alice: I own ci-runner-497 credentials. rotating now, pushing to vault -> deploy. ETA ~6m.
ben: quick note on impact: query shows 3 enterprise customers with elevated 401/403 spikes correlating to the window. notifying CSMs now.
ops-bot: Firewall ACL update applied: blocked 203.0.113.0/24 on edge-proxy (rule id: acl-enc-987).
maya: S3 logs show a PUT to external bucket `s3://external-debug-bucket/ingest/2967.log` at 21:12 UTC originating from staging-lambda role. file contains header snippets with `x-debug-token`.
secops: kickoff plan (P1 if token exposure confirmed): 1) immediate IP block, 2) rotate tokens & suspend affected clients, 3) scrub logs & request external S3 purge, 4) timeline + customer comms + legal hold as needed. assigning tasks now.
eli: I'll own timeline and the public/status draft. @secops you own key rotation and forensics. @alice confirm rotation done when complete.
alice: rotation complete. new token pushed to vault and idp-client restarted. verified successful handshakes to IdP.
ops-bot: Deployment restart: idp-client/ci-runner-497 restarted by alice.
maya: forensics: preserving full edge-proxy logs to secure storage: `/secure/forensics/INC-2026-0423-17.tar.gz`. also creating hash + chain-of-custody note.
secops: initiating KMS wrap-key rotation for that service token and issuing immediate rotate request for any related CI keys. filing ticket SEC-8723.
ben: CSMs notified (CS-4579). initial customer outreach sent to the 3 affected customers — no confirmed customer data exfil, but header values may have been included in debug dump. they asked for daily updates.
eli: drafting comms now. will post to #customer-updates in ~20m. keeping it factual: what happened, mitigation, next steps.
maya: requested purge from external S3 owner and opened contact channel with their infra team. also pulled object metadata: object size 4KB, single PUT, timestamp 2026-04-23T21:12:07Z.
ops-bot: S3 purge request completed: object `ingest/2967.log` removed from external bucket (confirmation id: purge-5599).
secops: Legal looped in: security-legal@redwood.com added to thread. holding onboarded evidence for potential disclosure.
ben: impact tracker updated: affected_customers=[org-alpha, org-kite, org-marigold], severity=medium for now. escalate criteria: >10 customers -> notify execs. current count=3.
eli: monitoring tight for 30m. if no further anomalous asserts, we'll transition to post-incident investigation runbook. I'll kick off a short bridge at +45m for timeline + comms signoff.
secops: note for postmortem: find root cause of debug header leak (staging forwarder config?), add stronger redaction filter at edge, and add CI deploy guard for debug-headers.
alice: confirmation: vault rotated, service account key replaced, deployments verified. leaving logs rotated and redaction rules drafted in repo `infra/edge-config` (PR #1427).
maya: forensics snapshot hashes: sha256: a3f1...4b9 saved to secure store.
eli: OK — containment progressing. updating incident channel + CSMs. will update again in 30m or sooner if status changes. :thumbsup:
pagerbot: INCIDENT STATUS: containment in progress — monitoring window open.
